reviews.comment:
Mejoró mucho. Le falta todavía. Agregaron WiFi para el pago QR en los surtidores, que antes no había. Siempre tiene gente, así que ir con paciencia. Parada obligada para muchos. Baños correctos. Precios del kiosco/bar elevados.

(Translated by Google)
It's much improved. There's still work to be done. They've added Wi-Fi for QR code payments at the pumps, which wasn't available before. It's always busy, so be prepared to wait. A must-stop for many. The restrooms are decent. Prices at the kiosk/bar are high.
